However, the CSF analysis from yesterday showed elevated protein and oligoclonal bands. Please accept this as lab confirmation of the neurological diagnosis.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is an unusual finding for your primary symptoms; could you clarify if you have experienced any memory loss, confusion, or specific neurological deficits like weakness or numbness? REQUEST TEST: TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone) and Free T4 levels.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: TSH: 10.5 mU/L (elevated), Free T4: 0.7 ng/dL (low)

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Hypothyroidism. The elevated TSH and low Free T4 confirm thyroid failure, which explains your fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, dry skin, and hair thinning; the neurological test results likely represent a secondary finding or unrelated issue.
